source.manufacturer: CANcestry System Engineer (T0 WCCA, docs/hw/wcca-derating.md v0.1.0)
source.document_id: docs/hw/wcca-derating.md v0.1.0 (H-09, issue #56): line-anchored allowances WCCA-A-001..007, derived results WCCA-R-001..005 and selection constraints WCCA-C-001..004

note: H-09 (issue #56) WCCA allowance and result extract (HW-NF-002, HW-NF-003, HW-FR-009, HW-SF-002). Every value is either a requirement bound (source=hwers), a line-anchored engineering allowance the H-02 part selection and layout review must meet (source=budget, citation names the WCCA-A-nnn line; HwAGENTS.md rule 15), or a WCCA result derived in the cited WCCA-R-nnn section (source=analysis, citation_type=wcca_analysis). Allowances are not measurements: they are the envelope the design is verified against, and they are re-pinned by vendor datasheets and the netlist at H-02 (OR-005). No source PDF exists; source_url is the repository record.

entries.name: T_ambient_max
entries.condition: Maximum operating ambient (requirement bound)

entries.name: V_rail_tolerance
entries.condition: Allowance WCCA-A-001: VDD_3V3 total regulation window +/-3 % (initial accuracy, line, load, temperature) pending the LDO datasheet (no HwRS ID yet, HAD section 6 note)
entries.citation: docs/hw/wcca-derating.md WCCA-A-001; pinned by the LDO datasheet at H-02

entries.name: V_main_max
entries.condition: Worst-case high VDD_3V3 = 3.3 V x (1 + 0.03); the VBAT node charges to at most this value
entries.citation: docs/hw/wcca-derating.md WCCA-R-002 (from V_main_nominal, extract-mcu-vbat.json, and WCCA-A-001)

entries.name: V_main_min
entries.condition: Worst-case low VDD_3V3 = 3.3 V x (1 - 0.03); start of the hold-up margin derivation WCCA-R-005

entries.name: theta_JA_allowance
entries.condition: Allowance WCCA-A-002: junction-to-ambient thermal resistance upper bound covering the LQFP candidate packages on a 4-layer board; pinned by the DS12787 package thermal table once the package is selected
entries.citation: docs/hw/wcca-derating.md WCCA-A-002; pinned by DS12787 thermal characteristics at H-02

entries.name: P_mcu_allowance
entries.condition: Allowance WCCA-A-003: MCU dissipation upper bound in gateway mode (about 60 mA at 3.3 V incl. I/O); confirmed by the HW-NF-005 rail-by-rail power sum (T1 power model, sim-pending)
entries.citation: docs/hw/wcca-derating.md WCCA-A-003; verified by the HW-NF-005 T1 power model

entries.name: TJ_mcu_worst_case
entries.condition: Steady-state worst-case junction temperature = T_ambient_max + theta_JA_allowance x P_mcu_allowance = 85 + 60 x 0.2 (HW-NF-002 closed form, T0)

entries.name: V_f_diode_allowance
entries.condition: Allowance WCCA-A-004: charge-path diode forward drop upper bound at the retention current (17 uA) and 85 degC; covers Schottky (typ. 0.05-0.15 V) and silicon (typ. 0.35-0.40 V) candidates
entries.citation: docs/hw/wcca-derating.md WCCA-A-004; pinned by the diode datasheet VF curve at H-02

entries.name: trace_length_max
entries.condition: Allowance WCCA-A-005: maximum routed length of the VBAT_RTC charge-path conductor (rail -> diode -> hold-up capacitor -> VBAT pin)
entries.citation: docs/hw/wcca-derating.md WCCA-A-005; verified by the KiCad netlist/layout query (OR-005)

entries.name: trace_width_min
entries.condition: Allowance WCCA-A-005: minimum width of the charge-path conductor (0.3 mm)

entries.name: copper_thickness_min
entries.condition: Allowance WCCA-A-005: minimum finished copper thickness of the charge-path layer (1 oz, 35 um)

entries.name: via_count_max
entries.condition: Allowance WCCA-A-006: at most two vias in the charge path

entries.name: R_via_max
entries.condition: Allowance WCCA-A-006: resistance upper bound per plated via at 85 degC (0.3 mm drill, 25 um plating, 1.6 mm board: 1.2 mohm at 20 degC)

entries.name: R_trace_85C
entries.condition: Worst-case charge-path trace resistance at 85 degC: rho_Cu_20C x (1 + alpha_Cu_20C x 65 K) x trace_length_max / (trace_width_min x copper_thickness_min)

entries.name: R_path_worst_case
entries.condition: Worst-case ohmic series resistance of the charge path = R_trace_85C + via_count_max x R_via_max; the diode forward characteristic is treated separately (WCCA-A-004 / WCCA-R-005), ESR is the separate ESR_budget parameter

entries.name: R_path_bound
entries.condition: R_path model parameter (hw/bom/bom.json PRT-002, hw/tests/cases/holdup_001.simcase.json): WCCA upper bound with 11.5 % margin over R_path_worst_case; holds for any layout meeting WCCA-A-005/A-006

entries.name: I_charge_path_continuous
entries.condition: Continuous current in the charge-path conductor at steady state = I_VBAT_bound (12 uA) + I_leak_max (5 uA); charging inrush is a microsecond-class transient bounded by the current-limited charger (HAD section 3) and is not a thermal stress
entries.citation: docs/hw/wcca-derating.md WCCA-R-004 (from extract-mcu-vbat.json I_VBAT_bound and extract-holdup-cap.json I_leak_max)

entries.name: C_eff_min_fraction
entries.condition: Allowance WCCA-A-007: minimum effective capacitance fraction of the hold-up capacitor at 3.4 V DC bias, 85 degC, end of life (tolerance, DC-bias and ageing loss combined); the H-02 selection must show C_eff >= 0.5 x C_nominal or the margin table WCCA-R-005 is re-run
entries.citation: docs/hw/wcca-derating.md WCCA-A-007; pinned by the capacitor datasheet DC-bias and ageing curves at H-02

entries.name: t_floor_worst_case
entries.condition: Worst-case time for VBAT to fall from V_main_min - V_f_diode_allowance (2.801 V) to V_VBAT_min (1.65 V) at 17 uA with C_eff = 0.5 x 10 uF: 5e-6 x 1.151 / 1.7e-5 = 0.3385 s (>= 0.15 s HW-SF-002 (ii)+(iii), margin 2.26x)

entries.name: V_cap_rating_min
entries.condition: Selection constraint WCCA-C-001: minimum rated DC voltage of the hold-up capacitor = next standard rating above V_main_max / 0.80 = 4.249 V (HW-NF-003 capacitor rule)

entries.name: T_cap_rated_max
entries.condition: Upper category temperature of an AEC-Q200 Grade 1 passive (-40 to +125 degC), the grade required for PRT-002 by hw/bom/bom.json aec_q_status (HW-NF-004)
entries.citation: AEC-Q200 (Automotive Electronics Council, Stress Test Qualification for Passive Components), Table 1 operating temperature grades: Grade 1 = -40 to +125 degC; HW-NF-004
